ux_intent: Validate that the policy text is fully scrollable, the accept CTA is gated behind an explicit checkbox (not scroll position), and the interaction between checkbox state and button enable/disable is clear and unambiguous.
figma_make_prompt:
Build an accept policy screen for the Hoopla digital library app.

Platform: mobile (iOS and Android), 390x844 base frame.
Use a top app bar with title "Terms of Service" and a back arrow.

Layout:
- Scrollable text area: full-width, 16px horizontal padding. Body Small 14sp #121212, line height 1.5. Policy text fills the viewport above the fixed footer.
- Fixed footer (pinned to the bottom, does not scroll with the text):
  - 1px divider #E5E7EB across full width.
  - Checkbox row (48dp height, 16px horizontal padding): checkbox 24x24dp (inside a 48x48dp touch target) left, label "I have read and accept the Terms of Service" (Body Small 14sp #121212) right.
  - "Accept" button: primary filled, full-width, 48dp height. Disabled (50 % opacity) when checkbox is unchecked; enabled (full opacity) when checked.

States:
- Default (checkbox unchecked): policy text at the top of the scroll. Checkbox unchecked (empty square, 1px border #6B7280). Accept button disabled.
- Checkbox checked: checkbox shows a checkmark (primary #6366F1 fill, white checkmark). Accept button becomes enabled (full opacity #6366F1).
- Accepted: brief success toast "Terms accepted" at the bottom of the screen (auto-dismiss 2 seconds). Screen navigates to the next onboarding step.

Behavior:
- Scroll the text area → standard vertical scroll. Footer stays fixed.
- Tap checkbox → toggle checked/unchecked. Accept button enable state updates immediately.
- Tap Accept (when enabled) → show accepted state.
- Tap back arrow → dismiss without accepting.

Style:
- Material 3-ish, light. Background #FFFFFF. Primary #6366F1. Disabled button 50 % opacity. Auto layout.

First step: default state with policy text visible at the top, checkbox unchecked, and Accept button in its disabled state in the fixed footer.
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given the checkbox is unchecked
When the user views the Accept button
Then it is visually disabled (50 % opacity) and does not respond to taps

Given the user checks the checkbox
When the state updates
Then the Accept button becomes full opacity and tappable, and the checkbox shows a primary-colour checkmark

Given the user taps Accept with the checkbox checked
When the action completes
Then a success toast appears and the screen transitions

Given the policy text is longer than the viewport
When the user scrolls
Then the footer (checkbox + button) remains fixed at the bottom while the text scrolls independently
manual_validation_checklist: Verify the footer is fixed: scroll the text and confirm checkbox and button do not move
Measure checkbox touch target: ≥ 48x48dp (pad around the 24x24dp visual square if needed)
Confirm Accept button is full-width, 48dp height. Disabled state is 50 % opacity; enabled is full opacity
Check policy text: Body Small 14sp, line height 1.5, #121212 on #FFFFFF — contrast ≥ 4.5:1
Verify checkbox label is Body Small 14sp and legible next to the checkbox
Confirm divider above the footer is 1px #E5E7EB and spans full width
